build_ddpmtloss_wrapper: build a DDPMTLoss wrapper with a custom loss function and mean reduction for DDP training
create_per_structure_loss: create a DDPMTLoss with per_structure reduction to compute loss normalized by free atoms per structure
register_mae_loss: register an MAELoss using L1Loss with none reduction for atom-wise absolute error computation
register_mse_loss: register an MSELoss using MSELoss with none reduction for atom-wise squared error computation
create_l2norm_loss: create an L2NormLoss to compute the L2 vector norm of prediction minus target differences
